author: GiacomoBoldrini
body:
#### PR description:

This PR removes the common mode attribute "cm" from the digi collection. As of now each digi (or physical cell ADC reading) carries a common mode attribute. This attribute is shared across one half-ROC so 37 digis will have the same value repeated. Instead, we read this value from the correct collection (`ECONDPacketInfo`), selecting the correct entry for the specific digis via `DenseIndex`. 

#### PR validation:

Latest IB at the time of MR

```
export SCRAM_ARCH=el9_amd64_gcc14
cmsrel CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-08-2300
cd CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-08-2300/src
cmsenv
#packages that may be affected
git cms-addpkg DataFormats/HGCalDigi
git cms-addpkg EventFilters/HGCalRawToDigi
git cms-addpkg RecoLocalCalo/HGCalRecAlogs
git cms-addpkg DQM/HGCAL
scram b
runTheMatrix.py-l 77.0
```

step1.root shows the same values for calibrated rechits. CM is correctly assigned to each channel
title: Remove HGCAL CM from Digi and read from ECOND
